thread:
zoe (marketing): quick sync  we want the release post + benchmark narrative + webinar RSVP live same day as canary. need exact changelog permalink, docs canonical URL, and a hard rollout window to announce. target Thu 10:00 PT for canary. ok?

pete (eng): Thu 10:00 PT is fine. final code freeze Wed 19:00 PT. i'll push the changelog after the freeze and paste the permalink here.

claire (docs): i'll finish the release page and the reproducibility guide. will add a short YAML snippet and an anonymized harness link. tentative docs URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1-2-0/ (will update once merged).

zoe (marketing): perfect. kelly, omar: for messaging do we want a headline "35% lower cost-per-token" or softer phrasing? also decide whether to publish raw harness or an anonymized artifact.

kelly (growth): headline is fine but add a qualifier: "on our embedding-heavy workload". publish anonymized harness + how-to guide, not infra details.

omar (product): agree with kelly. include a one-paragraph explainer of the workload and a short note about quantization and batching choices in the post. claire can link to the reproducibility guide.

pete (eng): benchmark numbers cleared. i'll share the harness repo internally and create a redacted public tarball link. changelog permalink will be: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/releases/tag/v1.2.0 (will confirm when tag created).

claire (docs): adding YAML snippet now. sample: ```yaml
workload: embeddings_heavy
seq_len: 768
dynamic_batching: true
quant_profile: q4_k
```

zoe (marketing): checklist for publish: changelog permalink, docs release page, benchmark charts + alt text, webinar RSVP link, embargo note, inbound lead routing (mailing list + hubspot tag). pete, can you confirm rollback criteria we should include in ops blurb?

pete (eng): canary window 90m. auto-revert if 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m or p99 > 2x baseline for 10m. ops will monitor and we have a hotfix runbook. i'll add that to the changelog ops section.

deploy-bot: scheduled staged rollout release/v1.2.0 -> canary cluster at 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z (90m canary). deployment id: rwd-deploy-279.

claire (docs): docs merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1-2-0/ and reproducibility guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1-2-0/repro. added YAML and anonymization guidance.

pete (eng): changelog tag created and permalink confirmed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/releases/tag/v1.2.0. ops blurb added.

zoe (marketing): thanks all  drafting the post now and will circulate to editorial + growth. scheduling webinar 45m after canary end and labeling it "initial findings". will paste final links here before publish. :rocket:
